Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).

Orange Cyberdefense has partnered with Mistral artificial intelligence for European artificial intelligence powered cybersecurity solutions. Confirmed by The Lufkin Daily News.
New York has enacted a law banning artificial intelligence emotional companions for minors, with age verification requirements now in place. Confirmed by kucoin.
